newsitem.title: BULGARIA: Bulgaria offers 3-, 6-mth discount T-bills Monday.
newsitem.headline: Bulgaria offers 3-, 6-mth discount T-bills Monday.

text.p: Bulgaria's Finance Ministry said it will offer on Monday two discount T-bill issues with a total par of 12 billion levs and with maturities of three and six months, respectively.
The government securities will be offered with no minimum acceptable prices set in advance.

The maximum amount of paper a single bank can buy at the auctions through competitive bids is set at 15 percent of the par value earmarked for such bids for the three-month maturity and 35 percent for the six-month T-bills.
Of the total par of the issues on offer 95 percent are earmarked for competitive bids and the remaining five percent for non-competitive bids.
Par value 4.0 bln levs 8.0 bln levs
